name: agro-popular-science-writer
description: A chat-first skill for researching, drafting and reviewing referenced agricultural popular-science articles.

interface.longDescription: A subject-first writing skill that researches evidence, suggests timely titles, recommends among ten author-informed editorial frameworks, verifies APA 7 references, revises the draft through a selected-framework editor and scores the final article in chat.
defaultPrompt: Plan a referenced article about an agricultural science topic
Suggest timely titles and the best writing framework
Check my evidence and APA 7 references before drafting
Edit my article with the selected framework and score the final version
